# Example GitHub Actions workflows

Non-active CI and manual protected sandbox promotion workflow examples. Rename and copy them into an intentionally chosen application repository only after review.

## Inventory

- [`ci.example.yml`](ci.example.yml)
- [`deploy-sandbox.example.yml`](deploy-sandbox.example.yml)

## Use

See the parent `examples/README.md` for safety prerequisites. Do not copy secrets, Terraform plans, or IAM session credentials into this repository.
